title: Hybrid Gated Attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.11805v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gated attention is an effective approach to mitigate attention sinks and enhance the representational capacity of attention. To further extend its effectiveness-efficiency Pareto frontier, we propose a Hybrid Gated Attention (HyGA) framework that contains three types of gating strategies. Specifically, these gates leverage diverse information from multiple stages of attention, and collaboratively build element-wise/head-wise gating from multiple perspectives, capturing intra-head and cross-head information interactions. Through our hybrid gating components, HyGA could provide multi-source modulation signals, enabling more comprehensive control over information flow and improving the representational capacity of attention. We also introduce low-rank matrix decomposition and learnable attention sink to further enhance training efficiency and stability. In experiments, we evaluate HyGA on widely-used benchmarks based on different backbones.

translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.11805v1 公告类型：新 摘要：门控注意力是缓解注意力汇聚和增强注意力表示能力的有效方法。为了进一步扩展其效率-效果帕累托前沿，我们提出了一种混合门控注意力（HyGA）框架，该框架包含三种类型的门控策略。具体来说，这些门控利用注意力多个阶段中的多样信息，并从多个角度协同构建元素级/头级门控，捕捉头内和头间的信息交互。通过我们的混合门控组件，HyGA能够提供多源调制信号，从而实现对信息流的更全面控制，并提高注意力的表示能力。我们还引入了低秩矩阵分解和可学习注意力汇聚，以进一步增强训练效率和稳定性。在实验中，我们基于不同骨干网络在广泛使用的基准上评估了HyGA。
tldr: 本文提出混合门控注意力框架，通过三种门控策略融合多头信息，结合低秩分解和可学习汇聚，显著提升注意力表示能力与训练效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Hybrid Gated Attention framework that integrates three gating strategies to fuse multi-head information, combined with low-rank decomposition and learnable sinks, significantly enhancing attention representational capacity and training efficiency.
